verdict.rationale: Release notes say Poke can create tables and charts from a described dataset or from images of spreadsheets, which covers the chart part of the story (poke-docs-21). Nothing in the evidence says Poke writes or runs code on user data, computes answers through execution, or produces downloadable files. Missing for 10: documented code-execution or sandbox capability, computed analysis on uploaded data files, downloadable file outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
